facts.fact: To be eligible for the Great Place to Work 2025 Best Workplaces for Inclusion list, organizations must be Great Place to Work-Certified and have exceptionally high employee scores on the Trust Index survey.
facts.quote: organizations must be Great Place to Work- Certified™ and have exceptionally high scores from employees on the Trust Index survey.

facts.fact: According to Great Place to Work's own description, it represents the voices of 500,000 employees across industry in Canada.
facts.quote: In Canada, Great Place to Work® produces both industry and demographic specific Best Workplace™ lists, and represents the voices of 500,000 employees across industry.
